## Skill Submission Checklist

- [ ] Folder name is kebab-case and matches the `id` field in `skill.json`
- [ ] `skill.json` includes all required fields: `id`, `name`, `description`, `version`, `author`, `tags`
- [ ] `skill.md` contains the Claude skill instructions and has been tested in Claude Code
- [ ] Description is clear and under 120 characters
- [ ] Tags are lowercase and accurately describe the skill
- [ ] No duplicate of an existing skill in the `skills/` directory
